summary.scope: Eligibility requires the complete original horizon without task termination or numerical failure. Prefixes and cancellations remain diagnostics. Streaming cost is included; no hardware or realtime qualification.

authored_sensor_outputs.availability: sample_time_s=null before first tick; otherwise values are held from that sample time

schedule.semantics: held authored samples; shared hybrid deadlines and registered sampling equations

authored_sensor_outputs.scope: authored simulated IMUs, separate from ideal task observations; not automatically used by rewards or termination

environment_contract.reward: change in net horizontal displacement from reset, in metres; undiscounted sum equals endpoint distance; divide by full configured duration for m/s

speed_task.failure: terminated episodes have diagnostic progress only; no eligible completed-episode score
speed_task.fall: body +Z world projection <= 0, transformed CAD hull vertex clearance <= 0, or positive body floor normal force
speed_task.observations: privileged task diagnostics, not actor sensor inputs
speed_task.sampling: transition endpoints; hull vertices against runtime floor/height field, not continuous CAD collision certification

environment_contract.termination_sampling: action transition endpoints; not physical travel stops

authored_imu_observations.availability: available=1 after first committed sensor tick; simulated sensor model, not hardware calibration
authored_imu_observations.before_first_sample: available=0; physical values and age are zero placeholders, not measurements
authored_imu_observations.definition_source: parsed CAD model, possibly including legacy schema defaults; inspect the original RobotDocument for authored omissions and provenance
authored_imu_observations.frame: authored sensor axes; acceleration channels are specific force, not world acceleration
authored_imu_observations.timing: held latest committed sample; age is observation time minus sample time

policy_contract.timing: Sample committed state before the next physics interval; targets are held until subsequent firmware sampling. Rendering does not set either clock.

input.frame_convention: SI; world is CAD export frame; link origin is COM with axes parallel to world at export; joint origins/axes are world-at-export

benchmark_assumptions.geometry: three solid PETG wheels, rectangular PETG chassis, library N20 motor bodies
benchmark_assumptions.joint_friction: estimated 0.0001 N m Coulomb and 0.00001 N m s/rad viscous per axle
benchmark_assumptions.mass: CAD volume and material density, plus library motor mass; no separate battery body modeled
benchmark_assumptions.purpose: exercise shared contracts and locomotion APIs on different morphology; not a manufactured robot specification
benchmark_assumptions.topology: two powered continuous axles and a passive continuous rear axle; no steering caster
